name: Kalimba dead-stroke ticks
desc: Percussive kalimba: heavily clipped, highpassed dead-stroke plucks reduced to woody ticks and buzzes, cycling a 16-step accent ostinato with speed wobble; reads as texture-percussion rather than melody, drops into any groove.

gain.doc: level (vcsl kalimba is quiet - keep high)

code.full: stack(s("kalimba kalimba ~ kalimba ~ kalimba kalimba ~ kalimba ~ kalimba ~ kalimba kalimba ~ kalimba").speed("[1.6 1.9 0 1.45 0 1.7 2.1 0 1.55 0 1.9 0 1.45 1.7 0 2]").clip(.12).shape(.5).hpf(${buzz}).gain("[.48 .26 0 .34 0 .3 .38 0 .44 0 .28 0 .36 .3 0 .4]").pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(12)), s("kalimba2 ~ ~ kalimba2").speed(.8).clip(.3).shape(.4).hpf(${buzz}*.5).gain(${gain}*.5).pan(.62)).room(.2).fast(${rate}).iter(4).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("kalimba kalimba ~ kalimba ~ kalimba kalimba ~ kalimba ~ kalimba ~ kalimba kalimba ~ kalimba").speed("[1.6 1.9 0 1.45 0 1.7 2.1 0 1.55 0 1.9 0 1.45 1.7 0 2]").clip(.12).shape(.55).hpf(${buzz}).gain("[.5 .3 0 .38 0 .34 .42 0 .48 0 .32 0 .4 .34 0 .44]").pan(sine.range(.38,.62).slow(10)).every(4, x=>x.ply("1 1 1 1 2 1 1 1")), s("kalimba2 ~ kalimba2 kalimba2").speed("[.8 0 .9 .72]").clip(.25).shape(.45).hpf(${buzz}*.5).gain(${gain}*.55).pan(.64), s("kalimba3*8").speed(2.4).clip(.08).shape(.4).hpf(${buzz}*1.4).gain(saw.range(.08,.2).fast(4)).pan(.35)).room(.2).fast(${rate}).iter(4).orbit(2).play()
